REED_RELIC_REEDS_SPEARHEAD.title: Reed's Spearhead
REED_RELIC_REEDS_SPEARHEAD.description: At the start of each turn, apply {Cards} [red]Scorch[/red] to ALL enemies.
REED_RELIC_HEART_OF_EMBERS.title: Heart of Embers
REED_RELIC_HEART_OF_EMBERS.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
REED_RELIC_RELIC_OF_THE_DRAGON.title: Relic of the Dragon
REED_RELIC_RELIC_OF_THE_DRAGON.descripti: At the start of each turn, gain {Cards} [gold]Strength[/gold].
REED_RELIC_FLAME_OF_VICTORIA.title: Flame of Victoria
REED_RELIC_FLAME_OF_VICTORIA.description: At the end of each turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to all enemies with [red]Scorch[/red].
REED_RELIC_ASHEN_CORE.title: Ashen Core
REED_RELIC_ASHEN_CORE.description: At the start of combat, gain 3 [blue]Ash[/blue]. Whenever you Exhaust a card, gain 1 [blue]Ash[/blue].
REED_RELIC_SCALE_FLAME_CHARM.title: Scale Flame Charm
REED_RELIC_SCALE_FLAME_CHARM.description: The first time you take damage in each combat, apply 3 [red]Scorch[/red] to the attacker.
REED_RELIC_CROWN_OF_THE_RED_DRAGON.title: A Floral Garland to the Red Dragon
REED_RELIC_CROWN_OF_THE_RED_DRAGON.descr: Whenever you apply [red]Scorch[/red] to an enemy, also apply 1 [red]Spell Vulnerable[/red].
REED_RELIC_ONES_OWN_CORNER.title: A Private Corner of One's Own
REED_RELIC_ONES_OWN_CORNER.description: When you take unblocked damage, apply that much [blue]Scorch Counter[/blue] to yourself.
